# PopForge

> Free website popup builder with 45 templates, a visual editor, hosted widget configuration and lead capture.

## Public product information
- [Overview and FAQ](https://popforge.shailu3597.workers.dev/): features, account requirements, supported triggers and limitations.
- [Template catalog](https://popforge.shailu3597.workers.dev/templates.html): all 45 starting designs grouped by purpose.
- [Installation guide](https://popforge.shailu3597.workers.dev/guides/install-popups.html): installation, platform constraints and troubleshooting.

## Product facts
- Guest users can design and preview. An account and saved widget are required for hosted install code.
- Supported automatic triggers: page load, delay, scroll depth, scroll to element, click and desktop exit intent. Choose one per widget.
- Custom HTML/JavaScript support is required on the destination website. Iframe embeds cannot escape their frame.
- Captured responses are associated with the owner's saved widget; API and account data are not public documentation.
- No conversion outcome or search ranking is guaranteed.
